40% (Quad) |time = 20:00 |rewards = {{Coins|950}}, {{Exp|185}} & {{TowerExp|120}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|For players who are experienced with the game and want a little challenge.|Description in Elevators}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Molten''' mode, formerly '''Normal''' mode, is one of the six main Survival modes. '''Molten''' mode has 35 waves. It is named after its final boss, the [[Molten Warlord]]. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. For example, the [[Molten Warlord]] gives {{Money|1,000}} after losing 1% of its health in solo, {{Money|500}} in duo, {{Money|333}} in trio and {{Money|250}} in quad between the players that damaged it. The health of enemies in this mode scales with the player count, starting at two players. The increase 15% in duo, 25% in trio and 40% in quad. It is applied after attributes, like [[Bloated]], meaning they can affect the health of an enemy. The increase is not always the stated amount. ==Rewards== ''For former rewards, see this mode's [[Molten Mode/Rewards|Rewards]] page.'' The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Some maps like [[Mason Arch]] can also increase all rewards by a specific amount. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards are calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward !Tower EXP Reward |- |{{Coins|550}} ÷ (1 + [(35 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^2.4) + {{Coins|400}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Exp|135}} ÷ (1 + [(35 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^2) + {{Exp|50}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{TowerExp|55}} ÷ (1 + [(35 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{TowerExp|65}} (Triumph Bonus) |} Triumphing '''Molten''' mode can give out an additional reward, which can be a crate, consumable or ticket. They are meant to be guaranteed, though due to a bug this does not always happen. Additionally, items are sometimes not given out. These items are: *{{Color|Common}} (55%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} (2-4) **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} (2-3) **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} (2-3) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **[[Barricade]] (2-4) **[[Supply Drop]] (2-4) **[[Easter Egg]] (2-4) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (35%) **[[Cooldown Flag]] (2-4) **[[Range Flag]] (2-4) **[[Damage Flag]] (2-4) **[[Mid Grade Crate]] **[[Ducky Squad]] (2-4) *{{Color|Rare}} (10%) **[[Napalm Strike]] (2-3) **[[Blizzard Bomb]] (2-3) **[[High Grade Crate]] ===Badges/Achievements=== There are [[badges]] and achievements that you can or could obtain when playing this mode, which may have additional rewards alongside them. These are: {{Badge |title = Defeat Molten Warlord |description = Well, that was a pretty heated battle. |image = D11MoltenBadge.png |obtainable = Yes }} {{Badge |title = Warlord |description = Triumph in Molten mode |image = Achievement |obtainable = Yes |rewards = {{Coins|375}} }} {{Badge |title = Paladin |description = Complete a match of Molten Mode on a Hard map(Solo) |image = Achievement |obtainable = Yes |rewards = {{Coins|750}} & 1x {{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} }} {{Badge |title = Slayer |description = Complete a match of Molten Mode on a{{sic}} Insane map(Solo) |image = Achievement |obtainable = Yes |rewards = {{Coins|1,000}} & 2x {{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} }} {{Badge |title = Obtained Cowboy |rewards = [[Cowboy]] |image = Cowboy5.png |obtainable = No }} ===Seasons=== During some [[Passes]], the '''Molten''' mode could give currency rewards which you used to progress through a season. 1 Total |} ==Wave Structure== Currently, the formula for calculating wave bonus depends on wave. Between waves 1 to 15, the wave bonus is calculated as: :{{Money|250}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|60}})^1.03 Between waves 16 and 35, it is calculated as: :{{Money|300}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|75}})^1.07 {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Players !Reduction per Player !Total Reduction |- |Solo |0% |0% |- |Duo |5% |10% |- |Trio |5% |15% |- |Quad |5% |20% |} For example, on Wave 2, the wave bonus is {{Money|317.84155407}}, rounded down to {{Money|317}}. The full number is used in the equation. In duo, it is {{Money|286}} ({{Money|286.057398663}} × 0.9), in trio, it is {{Money|270}} ({{Money|270.165320959}} × 0.85), while in quad it is {{Money|254}} ({{Money|254.273243256}} × 0.8). The wave clear bonus appears when every enemy from that wave was killed and no damage was dealt to the base health. It is 40% of the wave bonus in solo, while for duo, trio and quad it is 20%. Before 11th of December 2024, the formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave was: :({{Money|205}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|75}}) ÷ (1 - 0.1 × Players) Before 23rd of May 2024, the formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave was: :({{Money|180}} + ({{Money|75}} × Waves Completed)) × Players Before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], it was calculated as: :({{Money|50}} - 5 × (Players - 1)) × Waves Completed The waves in '''Molten''' mode follow these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-15 |1:00 |0:20Skip at 0:40. |- |16 |2:00 |0:40Skip at 1:20. |- |17-24 |1:00 |0:20 |- |25 |1:10 |0:23Skip at 0:47. |- |26 |1:15 |0:25Skip at 0:50. |- |27 |1:00 |020 |- |28 |1:05 |0:21Skip at 0:44. |- |29 |1:00 |0:20 |- |30 |3:00 |1:00Skip at 2:00. |- |31 |2:00 |0:40 |- |32 |3:00 |1:00 |- |33 |1:45 |0:35Skip at 1:10. |- |34 |1:20 |0:26Skip at 0:54. |- |35 |∞ |N/A |} '''Bolded''' names indicates an enemy type's debut. The total of enemies in '''Molten''' Mode excluding summoned enemies is 567 enemies. For former wave structures of '''Molten''' mode, visit the [[Molten Mode/Waves|Waves]] page.
